title: Flip Equivalent Binary Trees
problemStatement: Given the roots of two binary trees, determine whether one tree can be transformed into the other by repeatedly swapping the left and right children of any number of nodes.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first binary tree. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second binary tree.
output: • Print YES if the two trees are flip equivalent; otherwise print NO.
